text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower is convinced her misfortune brought about the accident at the Hanshin Racecourse and the resulting cancellation of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet despite the upset, her desire to run in the race and bring happiness to her fans is unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She negotiates with the staff at the Hanshin Racecourse, the Kyoto Racecourse, and even Director Akikawa, in hopes of finding a way for the race to go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moved by her determination, all parties cooperate with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result, the Takarazuka Kinen is moved to the Kyoto Racecourse.
